question: The Press and Registration of Books (PRB) Act was enacted in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1867**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Press and Registration of Books (PRB) Act was enacted in the year **1867**.
 
• The Act regulates the printing presses and newspapers and makes registration with an appointed authority compulsory for all printing presses.
